criteria.criterion: Grep of crates/athena-testutil/src/lib.rs shows one helper that writes an executable script via a temp file, close, chmod, then rename, and a run helper that retries on ETXTBSY; doc comments explain the ETXTBSY cause for an outside reader.
criteria.evidence: Read lib.rs: `write_executable` writes to `.<name>.<pid>.<n>.tmp` (std::fs::write closes the handle), sets mode 0755, then renames over the path. `retry_busy` retries up to 100 times, 20 ms apart, while the error text contains "Text file busy", and `run` wraps `Command::output` in it. The module docs explain the fork-inherits-writer race in three numbered steps. They also say the rename alone does not close the race and that every spawn must go through `run` or `retry_busy`.

criteria.criterion: Grep finds no write-then-from_mode(0o755) stand-in pattern left in xtask/src/main.rs (stand_in_claude), crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs or the tests of crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs; each calls the helper crate, which is a workspace member in Cargo.toml and a dev-dependency in the athena-agent, athena-core, athena-git, athena-cli and xtask manifests.
criteria.evidence: Grep for `from_mode(0o7` in the six files finds only xtask/src/main.rs:809, which is non-test `set_executable` and out of scope. Grep for `athena_testutil::` finds a call in each of the six files. Per the diff, Cargo.toml adds the crate to the workspace members and to workspace.dependencies, and all five manifests add `athena-testutil.workspace = true` under [dev-dependencies].

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-testutil`: a stress test writes and runs at least 200 scripts while other threads repeatedly fork/spawn processes, and none of the runs fails with ETXTBSY.
criteria.evidence: 3 passed, including `scripts_run_without_etxtbsy_while_other_threads_fork`: 8 writers × 50 = 400 scripts while 4 threads loop on `Command::new("true").output()`. It finished in 0.49s with busy == 0. Caveat: the test counts only failures left after retrying, so it never shows that the race happened on a first attempt (see findings).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass or are clean.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks for cd7a0c3 (CI run 42176001411): fmt, clippy and test all succeeded. I also ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --lib decision`, and its 12 tests passed.

criteria.criterion: docs/decisions.md ends with a new entry that says D08 was checked and stands, and docs/decision-links.toml has a [[link]] with older = "D08" and newer = that entry's id, whose line matches the phrase in the entry, so the decisions-reconciled check passes.

criteria.criterion: The diff touches only crates/athena-testutil, the manifests and Cargo.lock, the six listed test files, docs/architecture.md, docs/decisions.md, docs/decision-links.toml and CHANGELOG.md; athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: The diff stat lists 20 files. One of them, xtask/shard-timings.txt (two lines added), is not in the criterion's list or in the deliverables. The change is needed: xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411 `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` fails without it. athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unchanged. Non-test code in snapshot.rs is unchanged.

findings.summary: Soundness: most call sites only switched to write_executable; their stand-in runs are not retried, so the ETXTBSY flake can still happen there.
findings.evidence: The helper's own docs (lib.rs:22-25) and D157's Tradeoff say the rename does not close the race and the retry does: "Use `run` (or wrap the spawn in `retry_busy`) for every stand-in a test starts." Grep for `retry_busy` and ETXTBSY finds a retry only in reading.rs:8150 (and claude.rs, whose production code already had its own retry_busy). The xtask tests call `repin_at(&file, &bin)`, which runs the stand-in directly. The checks.rs test runs its `cargo` stub through the check runner, which has no retry. The flake the request targets therefore remains at these sites, and the change there does nothing. Simpler, correct fix: wrap those calls in `athena_testutil::retry_busy`, as reading.rs does (e.g. `retry_busy(|| repin_at(&file, &bin))`). Alternatively, `write_executable` could block until the file is executable, for example by retrying a trivial exec or an open with O_WRONLY until it no longer reports ETXTBSY, so every call site is covered.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG and D157 imply that every listed stand-in test is now protected from ETXTBSY.
findings.evidence: "runs them again while the kernel reports ETXTBSY ... The stand-in tests of xtask, athena-cli ..., athena-core (checks.rs, reading.rs) ... use it." Only reading.rs uses the retry. The others use only the write path, which the crate's own docs say does not fix the race.

findings.summary: A changed file is outside the deliverables list: xtask/shard-timings.txt.
findings.evidence: It adds `athena-testutil --doc 3.00` and `--lib 3.00`. The ci_shards test `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` requires these lines, so the change is justified. It is still not on the list, so criterion 7 is unmet as written. The 3.00 values look like placeholders, not measured timings (an estimate).

findings.summary: The stress test never shows that the race happens without the retry.
findings.evidence: It counts only ETXTBSY errors left after `run` has retried up to 100 times. A first-attempt ETXTBSY is never counted or reported, so a run where the race never occurred passes the same way. The behavior-evidence default asks the test to first show the failure without the protection, for example by counting first-try busy errors from a plain `Command::output()` under the same forkers.

summary: The candidate adds the athena-testutil crate, moves all six listed stand-in sites onto `write_executable`, and reconciles D08 correctly: D157 says "Amends D08 in prose only: D08 was checked and stands", and a matching [[link]] at line 4318 points to it. The decision tests I ran passed. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed. `cargo test -p athena-testutil` passed, including the 400-script stress test. The verdict is still fail, for two reasons. First, a major soundness problem: the crate's own docs say the rename does not close the ETXTBSY race and that every stand-in run must go through `run` or `retry_busy`. Yet only reading.rs wraps its run in the retry; claude.rs is covered by retry code it already had. The stand-ins in the xtask, checks.rs and reconcile.rs tests still run without a retry, so the flake the request targets can still reject jobs there, and the CHANGELOG and D157 overstate the fix. Second, the diff also changes xtask/shard-timings.txt, which is outside the deliverables list. A CI test needs that change, but it leaves criterion 7 unmet as written. Fix: wrap those spawns in `athena_testutil::retry_busy`, or make `write_executable` wait until the file is executable, and add shard-timings.txt to the deliverables.
